POINTS TO BE NOTED FOR REQUIREMENT OF CP PLUS CCTC CAMERA AND THEIR MICRO SD CARDS AS ME NTIONED BELOW :- 1. Outdoor Bullet Wi-Fi CCTV Camera – 1 No. Proposed Installation Location and Purpose: NTA Premises, Main GSD Building e ntrance: Required for the surveillance of the entrance view. Essential Technical Specifications: - Minimum 3 MP resolution. - Wi-Fi and RJ45 Ethernet connectivity. - Night vision, two-way audio and motion/human detection. - Minimum one-year manufacturer warranty. - MicroSD card support of at least 256 GB. - Reference model: CP PLUS EZ-R33G or equivalent. 2. Outdoor Wi-Fi Pan-Tilt (PT) CCTV Cameras – 2 Nos. Proposed Installation Locations and Purpose: NTA Premises, Main GSD Building Workshop Area: 01 no. required for the surveillance of the Workshop Area (inner view) & 01 no. required for the surveillance of the Workshop Area (outer view). Essential Technical Specifications: - Minimum 4 MP resolution. - Motorized pan/tilt functionality. - Wi-Fi and RJ45 Ethernet connectivity. - Night vision, human/motion detection and two-way audio. - MicroSD card support of at least 256 GB. - Minimum one-year manufacturer warranty. - Reference model: CP PLUS ezyKam+ CP-Z43Q or equivalent. 3. MicroSD Cards for above mentioned CCTV Cameras – 3 Nos. Purpose: Three MicroSD cards are required for the three CCTV cameras propose d above (01 outdoor bullet camera and 02 outdoor PT cameras) to facilitate loca l video recording and storage.

Essential Technical Specifications: - Compatible with the respective CCTV cameras. - Minimum storage capacity of 256 GB per card, subject to the camera's support ed capacity and compatibility. - Minimum Class 10, UHS-I U3 (UHS Speed Class 3) rating, ensuring a minimum sustained write speed of 30 MB/s. - High Endurance type, suitable for continuous CCTV video recording and repeat ed read/write operations. - Three cards in total, one for each camera. . 3.
